title: DriftState
description: Persisted in REGISTRY_KV under key `drift:{database}:{table}` and archived to R2 bucket chittyschema-drift-archive. Output of one drift-check run for one table.

baselineSignature.description: SHA-256 of the canonical column form at the time the baseline was set. Null until the first successful scan.

liveSignature.description: SHA-256 of the canonical column form from the most recent scan. Null if no scan has succeeded.

columnCount.description: Number of columns observed in the most recent scan.

status.description: baseline_set: first successful scan. ok: matches baseline. drift: differs from baseline. table_missing: information_schema.columns has no rows. not_configured: secret env var unbound. scan_error: connection or query failure.

lastDriftAt.description: Set when status transitions to drift; preserved across subsequent ok scans for forensic context.

error.description: Human-readable error when status is scan_error, table_missing, or not_configured.

diff.description: Symbolic delta between baseline and live. Populated when status is drift.
